findings.evidence: In the observed producer pre-reader bytes, positive-degree vanishing of F was asserted to make the unit k -> H^0(F;k) an isomorphism. Take base a point, F two discrete points, B=k[0], b=0 and R=1. All positive fibre cohomology vanishes and the finite-model hypotheses hold, but the diagonal unit k -> k^2 has cone H^0=k, contradicting concentration in degrees >=2. The claim needs k -> H^0(F;k) to be an isomorphism (nonempty connected F for these finite models), or a weaker valid bound. This is a historical finding in current-run batch 32, a direct supplier of the assigned Morse-data consumer. During this review its producer corrected the current carrier: Proof 6.1 now explicitly imposes the missing hypothesis and proves the bound. Current observed SHA-256 is 797fadb3b466341d74184d66692d80dd955b4c311e929fb76d65942d5cc0a590. The pre snapshot hash matches the raw bytes actually read and hashed before that correction; the corrected current bytes are not claimed as defective. The assigned interval/disk applications satisfy the missing condition.
